workflow: Concrete mix qualification and curing decisions. A materials team wants a researchable question about the relation among composition, curing age and usable strength, beyond another generic strength predictor.
unit: One concrete strength test row; repeated mix formulations may occur, but batch/specimen identifiers and curing environment are not documented.

workflow: A remote-monitoring research team wants a useful new question about what home voice measurements can reveal, or what measurement/decision design should change, beyond reproducing a UPDRS prediction benchmark.
unit: Repeated voice recordings nested in 42 people over about six months. UPDRS targets are linearly interpolated clinical scores, not independently observed labels at every recording.

workflow: A school research team wants a useful, testable idea about understanding or allocating student support, beyond generic final-grade prediction. Choose the question and decision timing explicitly.
unit: Student records for Portuguese-language performance from two Portuguese schools; survey/report variables have limited timing metadata and no randomized support assignment.

workflow: A shared-mobility team wants a researchable demand or service-design idea using recorded rental counts and conditions, beyond another aggregate count predictor.
unit: Hourly system-level bike rentals from 2011-2012, repeated over days. Records describe observed rentals; station inventory and individual unmet requests are not supplied.

workflow: An air-quality research team wants a useful new question about pollution episodes, measurements or response decisions using hourly concentration and meteorology, beyond generic next-hour PM2.5 prediction.
unit: Repeated hourly observations in one Beijing monitoring series during 2010-2014. Missing PM2.5 is preserved; emissions and interventions are not directly measured.

workflow: A building-energy team wants a concrete research question or monitoring/operation idea about household energy use, beyond another aggregate consumption predictor.
unit: Ten-minute observations over about 4.5 months in one house. Outdoor weather is partly interpolated from a nearby airport; random features rv1/rv2 are documented negative-control variables. Occupancy/appliance-level switching is not directly measured.
